summary: Pôle 3 (Médias & Enseignements) — full backend + frontend regression. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (seed, categories, filters, RBAC upload, streaming with Bearer & query token, cover, favorites, playlists, progress, delete cascade). Frontend: all critical testIDs render as specified (menu-medias-card, PÔLE 3 eyebrow, admin gear pasteur-only, 3-tab bottom nav, discover search+kind/category chips, library create-playlist modal, player modal with 7 controls, mini-player docks after close, empty-audio red banner). RBAC verified end-to-end: evangeliste sees 'Accès réservé' on /media/admin. Emergent Object Storage init log 'Object Storage initialised' confirmed at backend startup. Pôle 1/2 regression smoke passed (15 CCMG + 4 événements). No blocking issues.

issues: Console warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow' in web output. Emitted by several StyleSheet.create() rules. Cosmetic web-only warning; no functional impact.
Console warnings (non-blocking): props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Likely from a wrapping View/Pressable somewhere in the tree.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace remaining `shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius` StyleSheet keys with the RN 0.76+ `boxShadow` string form to silence web console warnings.
(Optional cosmetic) Move any `pointerEvents` prop into `style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}` on the underlying View to silence the deprecation warning.
Phase 2 (out of scope for now): background/lock-screen audio playback and PiP require a native build — Expo web preview cannot exercise them.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/media.py uses `expo-audio`-compatible endpoints (stream via Bearer OR ?token) — correctly matches web autoplay constraints.
MongoDB `_id` is properly excluded via `_doc_to_media()`/`_pl_doc_to_model()` mapping to Pydantic `id`.
RBAC enforced on POST /api/media, DELETE /api/media/{id}, and admin.tsx UI (Accès réservé for evangeliste).
Seed is idempotent (count-check) — safe on backend reload.
Cascade delete on DELETE /api/media/{id} correctly cleans playlists.item_ids, favorites, user_progress.
All interactive elements have testID (buttons, chips, inputs, tiles, player controls).
seed_data_creation: None. All TEST_ uploads and TEST_ playlists are auto-cleaned by the test suite (DELETE endpoints called). One 'TEST_UI_Playlist' was created via the UI test and remains — non-blocking; can be removed manually if needed.

Player modal testIDs: player-close/toggle/back10/fwd10/rate/sleep/fav/prev/next/progress.
